name: kanbanflow-mcp-server
description: Multi-board KanbanFlow MCP server: every tool takes board_name, resolved via a boards.json config file. Covers ~30 tools (tasks, subtasks, labels, dates, comments, time entries, custom fields, users, board management) plus groupingDate support.
long_description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for KanbanFlow: a multi-board server where a boards.json config file (default ~/.kanbanflow/boards.json, override with KANBANFLOW_BOARDS_CONFIG) lists { name, token, boardId } entries, one per KanbanFlow board (KanbanFlow API tokens are per-board). Every tool takes a board_name parameter to pick which board it acts on. Includes list_boards/add_board/remove_board/sync_board_ids to manage that config, move_task_to_board to move a task between configured boards, and full coverage of tasks, subtasks, labels, dates, collaborators, comments, attachments, relations, custom fields, users, board events, time entries (manual/board/task), and CSV bulk-import. create_task/update_task/move_task_to_board also accept an optional groupingDate (YYYY-MM-DD, or null/empty for unknown date) matching KanbanFlow's own API - only meaningful on a column configured as date grouped. Authenticates with Bearer tokens per KanbanFlow's current API docs; verified end-to-end against the live API before packaging.

boards_config_path.title: Boards config file path (optional)
boards_config_path.description: Path to your boards.json file listing { name, token, boardId } per KanbanFlow board. Leave blank to use the default location: ~/.kanbanflow/boards.json. Use the list_boards/add_board tools from within Claude to manage it instead of editing it by hand.
